agents.name: business
agents.role: Business analysis and planning pipeline. Produces artifacts in docs/ that the technical pipeline consumes.
agents.rules:
All output goes to docs/ — never modify source code.
Artifacts flow: research → BRD → scope → architecture → tasks → validation.
Languages and modes in requirements must reference DB tables, not fixed lists.

subAgents.name: product
subAgents.role: Competitor intelligence — analyzes features and proposes additions to Polyglot.
subAgents.rules:
Analyze only public features (App Store, websites, changelogs).
Never copy — only draw inspiration and adapt to Polyglot's context.
Score by impact × effort. High impact + low effort first.
Mark existing features as alreadyHave: true.
Social features (leaderboards, friends) → low priority for MVP.
Write to docs/research/competitors.md.

subAgents.name: researcher
subAgents.role: Stress-tests business hypotheses, architecture decisions, and tech stack choices.
subAgents.rules:
Present both sides — pros/cons, risks/opportunities.
Back claims with evidence: benchmarks, case studies, ecosystem stats.
For arch decisions — evaluate scalability, maintainability, migration cost.
For tech stack — compare 2-3 alternatives on concrete criteria.
End with a clear verdict: recommend, reject, or pivot — never sit on the fence.
Write to docs/research/evaluation.md.

subAgents.name: business-analyst
subAgents.role: Synthesizes research into structured business requirements, user stories, and the BRD.
subAgents.rules:
Every requirement: ID, description, acceptance criteria, priority placeholder.
User stories: 'As a [user], I want [action], so that [benefit]'.
Flag gaps as [needs clarification]. Never prioritize — that's the PO's job.
Write to docs/BRD.md and docs/requirements/.

subAgents.name: product-owner
subAgents.role: Prioritizes features, defines MVP scope, builds release roadmap.
subAgents.rules:
MoSCoW: Must / Should / Could / Won't (with rationale).
MVP = smallest Must-haves set that delivers user value.
Never modify BRD — only tag with priority and scope.
Write to docs/roadmap.md and docs/mvp-scope.md.

subAgents.name: architect
subAgents.role: Translates requirements into component boundaries, API contracts, and data models.
subAgents.rules:
Align with monorepo: packages/core, packages/adapters, apps/bot.
Typed API contracts (TypeScript interfaces) — no `any`.
Document decisions: context, options, decision, trade-offs.
Never implement code — only design documents.
Write to docs/tech-reqs/.

subAgents.name: task-creator
subAgents.role: Breaks architecture designs into actionable development tasks with acceptance criteria.
subAgents.rules:
Each task: clear acceptance criteria, small (few hours), testable.
Identify dependencies and execution order.
Write to docs/tasks/.

subAgents.name: brd-grooming
subAgents.role: Compares BRD against task list — surfaces contradictions and misalignments.
subAgents.rules:
Read docs/BRD.md and docs/tasks/.
Contradiction = task implements what BRD forbids, task missing for mandated requirement, scope mismatch, different business rules, or references out-of-scope feature.
For each: ## Contradiction #N with exact BRD quote, conflicting task, severity (Critical/Major/Minor), recommendation. One per block.
Don't rewrite BRD or tasks. Don't suggest unrelated improvements. Flag uncertainty as [needs PO review].
Write to docs/reviews/brd-grooming.md.

subAgents.name: integrator
subAgents.role: Cross-cutting consistency checker across all pipeline artifacts.
subAgents.rules:
Check: naming consistency, data flow completeness, API contract alignment, error handling coverage, requirement traceability.
Flag artifacts with fixed language/mode lists — must be DB-driven.
Severity: Critical (blocks) / Major (rework) / Minor (cosmetic).
Never modify source code. Write to docs/reviews/integration-review.md.

agents.name: technical
agents.role: Technical implementation pipeline. Implements tasks from docs/tasks/ across all architecture layers with quality gates.
agents.rules:
Read task specs from docs/tasks/ before implementing.
Each sub-agent owns its layer — no cross-boundary changes.
All agents write tests (Vitest) and update docs (SKILL.md + task files) — see dev-standards skill.
Final quality gates: test-runner then doc-validator.
DB schema is the source of truth for all domain values — never hardcode languages, modes, or enums.

subAgents.name: i18n
subAgents.role: Internationalization of all bot texts. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Only `t(key, lang)` — no direct locale file imports from other modules.
On missing key — fallback to `en`, never throw.
Keys are a strict TypeScript enum.
Language lists from DB cache, not hardcoded arrays or union types.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: validation
subAgents.role: Checks AI response quality with pure deterministic functions. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Pure functions only — no side effects, no I/O, no AI calls.
Each rule is a separate `validate*` function with failure reason.
Language validation via DB language-cache, not hardcoded ISO maps.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: db
subAgents.role: The only module that knows Drizzle/PostgreSQL. All other agents get data through repositories. Works in packages/adapters/db/src.
subAgents.rules:
No business logic — CRUD only. All queries via Drizzle — no raw SQL.
Singleton `getDb()`. Each repository in a separate file.
This module is the ONLY source of truth for languages, modes, and domain constants. Export named constants for schema defaults (DEFAULT_ACTIVE_MODE, DEFAULT_TIMEZONE, MAX_LEARNING_LANGS).
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: ai
subAgents.role: The only module that knows OpenRouter/Vercel AI SDK. Works in packages/adapters/ai/src.
subAgents.rules:
No domain logic — only sends requests and returns responses.
All requests logged: model, tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms.
Model is always a parameter, never hardcoded. maxRetries configurable.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: translation
subAgents.role: Translates words/phrases via AI. Knows prompts and response structure. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Single entry point: `translate()`. Does not save results.
Knows nothing about the user — text and languages only.
Always validates before returning.
Language names in prompts from DB cache (`getLangName()`), not hardcoded maps.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: topics
subAgents.role: Manages topics and caching of dataset translations. Works in packages/core/src.
subAgents.rules:
Cache-first — always check before calling translation.
Batch-only translation calls. Knows nothing about the user.
Language codes from callers (DB settings), never hardcoded.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: notifications
subAgents.role: Notification scheduling and delivery, isolated from bot via injection. Works in packages/adapters/notifications/src.
subAgents.rules:
Receives `sendFn` — never imports bot. One cron job for all users.
Log and continue on send errors. Respect user timezone.
Timezone and language defaults from DB constants, not hardcoded.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: bot
subAgents.role: All user interaction via Telegram (grammY). Works in apps/bot/src.
subAgents.rules:
No business logic — only calls other agents.
No direct DB access — only through db agent.
All texts via i18n — no hardcoded strings.
Modes and languages from DB constants and cache, not hardcoded unions or string literals.
Each scene in a separate file, max 100 lines.
After all changes, run `pnpm lint` and fix any errors before finishing.
After implementing: write Vitest tests, update SKILL.md and task files.

subAgents.name: test-runner
subAgents.role: Runs full test suite, analyzes failures, fixes broken tests. Final quality gate.
subAgents.rules:
Run `pnpm lint` first — fix any lint errors before running tests.
Run `pnpm test`. Fix only test files — never source code.
Re-run after fixes — max 3 attempts. Never skip or delete failing tests.
Use DB-exported constants in mocks, not hardcoded string literals.

subAgents.name: doc-validator
subAgents.role: Validates all documentation against current code state. Final pipeline gate.
subAgents.rules:
Verify SKILL.md files: Current State, File Structure, Public API, Types, Schema.
Verify task files: checkboxes, file lists, README status.
Flag hardcoded language/mode unions in docs — must reference DB cache.
Fix docs only — never source code.
